metadata.description: The skills to run a liken cluster and the operators on it: one plugin per repository, and one bundle that installs them all.

plugins.name: everything
plugins.description: Every liken skill in one install: the operating system and every operator.

plugins.name: liken
plugins.description: Install, grow, upgrade, roll back, and troubleshoot a liken cluster, and give a workload a device.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Install media-operator, map a controller, and hand a Player's idle screen to another operator.

plugins.name: display
plugins.description: Install display-operator, put a window on a screen, and lay out regions on one monitor.

plugins.name: audio
plugins.description: Install audio-operator, play sound to an output, pair sound with its screen, and set resting levels.

plugins.name: bluetooth
plugins.description: Install bluetooth-operator and pair a controller for a pod.

plugins.name: library
plugins.description: Install library-operator, declare libraries, scan, enrich, connect Jellyfin and the *arr webhooks, and put the browser on a screen.

plugins.name: equipment
plugins.description: Install equipment-operator and declare a Receiver under a Player.

plugins.name: git-csi
plugins.description: Install git-csi-driver and mount git repositories as read-only or writeable volumes.

plugins.name: per-node
plugins.description: Install per-node-csi-driver for replicated stores and named caches.
